name: Wish
summary: Duplicate any spell ≤8th level, or attempt a greater effect — with risk.
description: Safest use: duplicate any 8th-level or lower spell (no components). Other uses (max HP, redo a roll, reshape reality) risk stress: never cast wish again on a failed 33% check, and suffer temporary ability weakening.
notes: DM adjudication for creative wishes is essential.
